system.description:
You cause flora to spontaneously shift and grow.

Choose a point within 10 spaces.

You can move plants in that area to an adjacent space or lift them 1 space in the air, but no higher.

Alternatively, you can cause plants of your choice to spontaneously grow in the area, though they must be native to the biome you are in.

Rock and most man-made structures are destroyed as the sudden growth takes root and forces them aside.

Additionally, you can shape the growth of plants in the area, such as clearing a path through a dense thicket.

Your control over the plants lasts until the start of your next turn, after which any plants grown by this spell wither and die.

While this spell is active, you can use an Action to shape plants again, selecting the same target, or a new target as you wish. If you select a new target, you relinquish control over the previous target.

Each extra success extends the duration by +1 rounds.

Effect: @UUID[Compendium.titan-vttrpg-compendium.effects.ActiveEffect.9pqAMkvT8YpvBasV]{Shape Forest}
